question: What is the value of (13 times 4-26)/(54-7 times 4) ?
solution:
**Given:**

(13 times 4 - 26)/(54 - 7 times 4)

**Formula used:**

BODMAS rule

**Calculation:**

(13 times 4 - 26)/(54 - 7 times 4)

⇒ (52 - 26)/(54 - 28)

⇒ (26)/(26)

⇒ 1

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**
